repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 180 ticks, which corresponds to only 180 seconds (3 minutes) if the counter started at 0 and required 180 increments. However, the IR requires the condition to be sustained for the full 3 minutes (180 seconds). With a 1000 ms period, the script cannot observe the condition dropping and returning between iterations to verify the full duration. The correct approach is to use a 100 ms wrapper period, where 3 minutes equals 1800 ticks. The threshold must be 1801 to ensure the condition holds for 1800 full ticks (0 to 1799) before triggering at the 1801st tick.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period from 1000 to 100 ms to allow fine-grained observation of the sustained condition. Updated the threshold from 180 to 1801 to correctly represent a 3-minute (1800 tick) duration on the 100 ms grid, ensuring the action fires only after the condition has been continuously true for the required time.
